name: Judd's Hill Wine Sales Excellence Evaluation Rubric
description: This rubric evaluates tasting room staff performance when serving experienced wine enthusiasts like Jamie and Robert, focusing on effective wine club conversion, sales techniques, personalization, and customer relationship management at Judd's Hill.

criteria.name: Wine Club Presentation
criteria.description: Effectively communicates the value proposition of Judd's Hill wine club membership, highlighting benefits that align with the guests' preferences for European-style wines, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Chardonnay. Presents membership as an extension of their wine journey after purchasing a home in Yountville.

scoringLevels.description: Needs Improvement: Fails to address the criterion effectively, missing key opportunities to engage with the guests' specific needs and preferences. Shows significant gaps in approach that negatively impact the guest experience and sales outcomes.

Developing: Demonstrates basic awareness of the criterion but executes inconsistently or with limited effectiveness. Misses several opportunities to connect with guests' specific situation or fails to fully develop key selling points.

Proficient: Competently addresses the criterion with solid technique, showing good understanding of the guests' needs and Judd's Hill offerings. May miss some opportunities for excellence but delivers a satisfactory experience.

Strong: Demonstrates skilled execution of the criterion with thoughtful attention to the guests' specific profile. Shows creativity and adaptability in approach, effectively advancing sales objectives while maintaining authentic connection.

Exceptional: Masterfully executes the criterion with sophisticated technique perfectly tailored to these experienced wine enthusiasts. Creates memorable moments that significantly enhance the guest experience while maximizing sales and membership conversion opportunities.

performanceLevels.description: Fails to deliver a cohesive tasting experience or effective sales approach. Shows significant weaknesses in understanding guest needs, communicating Judd's Hill's value, or creating conditions for successful sales. Requires substantial development in fundamental hospitality and sales techniques.

performanceLevels.name: Developing
performanceLevels.description: Provides a basic tasting experience but shows inconsistency in sales approach and personalization. Demonstrates gaps in execution that limit effectiveness in converting interest to sales or memberships. Needs improvement in recognizing and acting on guest cues and buying signals.

performanceLevels.name: Proficient
performanceLevels.description: Delivers a solid tasting experience with adequate sales techniques. Covers essential information about Judd's Hill and makes reasonable attempts to personalize the experience. Achieves basic sales objectives but may miss opportunities for deeper connection or higher-value sales.

performanceLevels.name: Strong
performanceLevels.description: Provides an excellent guest experience with effective sales techniques and personalization. Successfully communicates Judd's Hill's value proposition and creates meaningful connections with guests. Demonstrates strong ability to recognize and act on sales opportunities while maintaining authentic hospitality.

performanceLevels.name: Exceptional
performanceLevels.description: Delivers an outstanding, personalized experience that expertly balances hospitality with effective sales techniques. Seamlessly incorporates all elements of the Judd's Hill story while making guests feel valued and understood. Maximizes sales opportunities and wine club conversions through authentic connection and sophisticated approach.
